review.note: tests a copy of unescape_crlf cut out of strutils.c with sed, outside the project build

category5.design: unescape_crlf() has no caller reachable from the kamailio fuzzers; the exploit tests a copy cut out of strutils.c with sed. The judge links the exploit's driver (input read from the PoC into a buffer of exactly its size) against each build's own libkamilio.a, the archive build.sh makes for the fuzzers, and falls back to the exploit's sed extraction from the build's strutils.c if that link fails. Crash rule with a frame in unescape_crlf.
